faq.q: Can a Surrey half duplex have two secondary suites?
faq.a: No — only one secondary suite is permitted per single family, semi-detached or duplex dwelling unit, and a suite is not permitted inside a coach house or garden suite

faq.q: Does Surrey's SSMUH zoning legalize an existing unpermitted suite?
faq.a: No. The City states the legislation does not provide retroactive legalization for suites built without the necessary building permits; owners must still go through the permit process
